message.content: In the discussions, multiple solutions are proposed to make the garden more comfortable on sunny days. One suggestion is to install a small water feature, which could add soothing sounds and attract wildlife. Additionally, the group considers adding plants around the water feature to enhance its visual appeal and create a more natural environment. Another idea mentioned is the installation of some shade, such as umbrellas or a pergola, around the seating areas to keep the space cool and comfortable during the warmer months. These proposals aim to create a versatile and enjoyable space that caters to various weather conditions throughout the year.
